info.title: onemodelcontext: a command line for servers that speak the Model Context Protocol®.
info.description: The onemodelcontext command line tool for OneModelContext: a .NET SDK for the Model Context Protocol®. Model Context Protocol® is a registered trademark of LF Projects, LLC; OneModelContext is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by LF Projects, LLC or the Model Context Protocol project.

options.name: --era
options.description: protocol era (default auto: modern first, legacy on fallback)

options.name: --json
options.description:
print JSON (also --output json); with a value (@file or '{...}') it gives call arguments
--arg k=v, -a k=v          a tool or prompt argument; typed from the tool's input schema

options.name: --yes
options.description: answer yes when a server asks to confirm

options.name: --bearer
options.description: bearer token for an http(s) server (sent as a header, never in the URL); overrides stored tokens

options.name: --token-store
options.description: where login keeps tokens

options.name: --verbose
options.description: show the server process's standard error

options.name: --config
options.description: server names file

options.name: --version
options.description: exit codes: 0 ok, 1 server error or tool isError, 2 usage, 3 transport, 4 authorization, 130 cancelled
